data.name: Ilakkiya
data.gender_notes: Ilakkiya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ilakkiya is the name of the goddess of illusion, known as Maya in Hindu mythology. She is the creator of the universe through her power of illusion. This name is believed to bestow the ability to see beyond the physical world and understand the deeper truths of existence. The name Ilakkiya carries the meaning “Goddess of Illusion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ilakkiya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of illusion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Granted the ability to see beyond illusion and perceive the truth.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ilakkiya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Ilakkiya was a famous Tamil poet of the Sangam age, who lived around the 2nd century BC. He is known for his works in the Agam and Agananuruppatai collections.

Ilakkiya is also known for his association with the Chola dynasty, specifically with the reign of Rajaraja Chola I (985-1014 AD). He was a court poet during this period and his works were highly regarded.
